_comment: Minimal intake for 'Análise de Estudo 2 — Teste de Burnout'. CORRECTED 2026-10-17: this file and 2.relational.model.psychometrics/samples.SQL/manual_load_study2_burnout_test.sql originally assumed this study would get ID_STUDY=2 (hardcoded, since GEN_ID(SEQ_GDX_PSY_STUDY, 0) was still 0 when the SQL script was written). That manual script was apparently never actually run -- GDX_PSY_STUDY has no row with this title. ID_STUDY=2 is correctly and permanently 'Purpose Orientation (OT-7) - Exploratory Pilot Study' (loaded later through the normal GDX_SKILL_RECORD_NEW_STUDY pipeline, which let the SEQ_GDX_PSY_STUDY trigger assign the next free id). This burnout study is NOT currently loaded into the database at all -- --study burnout-test-2 will keep failing with 'Study not found' on any --study-scoped skill until someone actually runs the (now also corrected) manual_load_study2_burnout_test.sql. This study was never meant to run GDX_SKILL_NEW_STUDY's interview or GDX_SKILL_RECORD_NEW_STUDY, because it introduces no new instrument -- it reuses the existing Maslach Burnout Inventory - Student Survey catalog entry (ID_INSTRUMENT=9) verbatim. This file exists ONLY so --study burnout-test-2's slug/title resolution works for GDX_SKILL_EXPORT_NEW_STUDY (and any other --study-scoped skill) once that row actually exists -- it deliberately omits the constructs/variables/items GDX_SKILL_RECORD_NEW_STUDY would need, since none of that needs creating: the instrument, its items and its alternatives already exist in GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT/GDX_PSY_INSTRUMENT_ITEM/GDX_PSY_ITEM_ALTERNATIVE. name/version below are copied verbatim from that existing catalog row.

study.title: Análise de Estudo 2 — Teste de Burnout
study.objective: Identificar quando/se uma pessoa está em estado de estresse (burnout).

instruments.name: Maslach Burnout Inventory - Student Survey (hypothesis - unconfirmed)
